title: 第三章 马下得生骑士的事情第四章 精神提升剑术老师
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: “停下！”
“住手！”
千钧一发之际，两个声音同时响起。
拉福林一步踏下，强悍的身体化作一道虚影，朝着发狂的公马冲了出去。
可就赶到的瞬间，他却发现白色大马的动作突然停止。
此时的亚瑟看着面前那崭新的，还折射着冷光的蹄铁。
他两腿一软，一屁股瘫在了自己的尿里。
拉福林原本提起的心，此时也松了下来。
就差一点。
差一点锡林伯爵的儿子就死在了自己的马厩里。
此时的拉福林看着原本发狂的公马此时如雕塑般停在了半空，眼中流露出一丝惊奇。
“冷静点，小白。过来。”
门口再次传来了少年的声音。
拉福林看向门口。
白色公马就像是听到了什么无法违抗的命令，踩着优雅的步伐朝着门外走去。
原本高昂的马头此时渐渐低了下去，凑到了少年身前。
“不是教过你，除了在战场上，不能伤人。”
白马委屈的在少年的身边绕了一圈，然后将脑袋停在了李奥的面前。
拉福林满脸惊愕，刚刚阻止这场惨剧的不是自己，而是这个少年。
看着少年亲热的抚摸着他的白马，拉福林双眼微张，“我的马？这家伙什么时候……这么听话了。”
李奥捡起缰绳，牵着白马朝拉福林走来，庄重地行了个骑士礼，“尊敬的拉福林阁下。”
而此时边上另外两匹马也从侍童的手里挣脱，乖巧的凑到了李奥的身后。
拉福林转过头，看了眼走到他身边的伯顿。
面对这个场景，两人一时不知都该作何反应。
即使是卢卡这老马夫，也从没有让这几匹马这么听话过。
“你是李奥莱德，黑水城领主让莱德的儿子。”拉福林走到李奥面前，第一次仔仔细细将面前这个少年打量了一遍。
“是的，阁下。”李奥将手中的缰绳递还给了一旁瘫坐在地的亚瑟，“小白他不喜欢被人用力拽着。”
“哦……哦……”亚瑟顺着手里的缰绳，看到几秒钟前，差点杀死自己的高大白马正盯着自己。
那恐怖的记忆再次涌入脑海，他猛地将缰绳一扔，朝后迅速挪动屁股，在地上拖出一道明显的尿痕。
拉福林斜了眼这个胆小的伯爵之子，转过头走到李奥面前。
他饶有兴趣捏了捏李奥的肩膀，“没想到，让莱德的儿子对于马术这么有天赋。”
此时一直缩在后面的伯顿开口应和，“是啊，拉福林阁下，这黑水城的孩子对养马还真挺有一手的。”
“养马？骑士那叫养马？”拉福林提高语调，不再搭理这个老管家，而是继续看向李奥，“小李奥，帮我把这几匹马都带到后院拴好吧。”
“遵命阁下。”李奥解开马棚里另外三匹马的缰绳，老练的将拇指和食指含在口中，吹了个嘹亮的马哨。
六匹马听到哨声，并排走到李奥身前，排成了一列。
然后他们便跟在李奥后头，整齐地走出了马厩。
“李奥少爷，干的好。”门口的卫兵查理压低声音，冲李奥使了个眼色。
李奥微笑点头，转头则是继续看向了自己的面板。
如果不是【御马】技能，刚刚那亚瑟已经死了。
方才他只是下意识喊了一句。
前世的本能让他不能看着一个孩子被马活活踩死。
纵使那亚瑟有些目中无人，但说到底他也没做过什么伤害自己的事。
“只是有些贵族子弟的孩子气罢了。”
两世为人，李奥不会为这点鸡毛蒜皮和他计较，他有自己更重要的事要做。
content_en:
"Stop!"
"Stop!"
At the critical moment, two voices sounded at the same time.
Laughlin took a step forward, his powerful body turned into a shadow, and rushed towards the mad stallion.
But the moment he arrived, he found that the movement of the big white horse suddenly stopped.
At this time, Arthur looked at the brand new shoe in front of him that still reflected the cold light.
His legs went weak and he collapsed in his own urine.
Laughlin's originally worried heart relaxed at this time.
Just a little bit.
The son of Count Silin almost died in his stable.
At this time, Laughlin watched the originally crazy stallion stop in mid-air like a sculpture, with a trace of surprise in his eyes.
"Calm down, Xiaobai. Come here."
The boy's voice came from the door again.
Laughlin looked toward the door.
The white stallion walked toward the door with elegant steps, as if he had heard some order that he could not disobey.
The originally high horse's head gradually lowered and came closer to the young man.
"Didn't I teach you not to hurt others except on the battlefield?"
The white horse circled around the young man aggrievedly, and then stopped his head in front of Leo.
Laughlin's face was full of shock. It was not him who had just prevented this tragedy, but this young man.
Seeing the young man caressing his white horse affectionately, Laughlin opened his eyes slightly, "My horse? When did this guy... become so obedient?"
Leo picked up the reins, led the white horse towards Laughlin, and solemnly performed a knight's salute, "Dear Sir Laughlin."
At this time, the other two horses on the side also broke away from the hands of the waiter and obediently got behind Leo.
Laughlin turned his head and glanced at Burton who came to him.
Faced with this scene, the two of them didn't know how to react.
Even Luca, an old groom, has never made these horses so obedient.
"You are Leo Ryder, the son of Lord Jean Ryder of Blackwater City." Laughlin walked up to Leo and looked at the young man in front of him carefully for the first time.
"Yes, Your Excellency." Leo handed the reins back to Arthur, who was slumped on the ground. "Xiaobai doesn't like being pulled hard."
"Oh...oh..." Arthur followed the reins in his hand and saw the tall white horse that almost killed him a few seconds ago staring at him.
The horrific memory flooded into his mind again. He threw the reins away and quickly moved his butt backwards, leaving an obvious urine mark on the ground.
Laughlin glanced sideways at the timid son of an earl, turned his head and walked to Leo.
He squeezed Leo's shoulder with interest, "I didn't expect Ryder's son to be so talented at equestrian."
At this time, Burton, who had been shrinking back, responded, "Yes, Mr. Laughlin, this kid from Blackwater City is really good at raising horses."
"Raising horses? What do knights call raising horses?" Laughlin raised his tone and stopped talking to the old butler, but continued to look at Leo, "Little Leo, please help me take these horses to the backyard and tie them up."
"Your Majesty." Leo untied the reins of the other three horses in the stable, expertly put his thumb and index finger in his mouth, and blew a loud whistle.
The six horses heard the whistle and walked up to Leo side by side, forming a line.
Then they followed Leo and walked out of the stable neatly.
"Master Leo, you did a good job." Charlie, the guard at the door, lowered his voice and winked at Leo.
Leo smiled and nodded, then turned and continued to look at his panel.
If it weren't for the [Horse Control] skill, Arthur would have been dead just now.
Just now he just shouted subconsciously.
The instinct in his previous life prevented him from watching a child being trampled to death by a horse.
Even though Arthur was a little arrogant, in the end he didn't do anything to hurt himself.
"It's just the childishness of some noble children."
As a man of two generations, Leo would not care about such trivial matters with him. He had more important things to do.
